classifiedFinding.title: ERC1155 receiver hook callback path on unstake / emergencyWithdraw exposes a defensive-depth surface; mitigated by nonReentrant + checks-effects-interactions

attackPath: None observed under nonReentrant + state-before-transfer ordering.
classification.assumptions: ReentrancyGuard remains correctly applied across all user entrypoints.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low / defensive-depth note. All user entrypoints are nonReentrant and follow checks-effects-interactions. Cross-function re-entrancy from the ERC1155 callback into a non-guarded view function is theoretically possible but views cannot mutate state. Acceptable as-is.
